$comment: Claude Code project MCP entry for the rebar MCP server (epic jira-reb-3527 'Enable
MCP on AWS', ADR 0104 / deft-evolutive-mosasaur — nginx /mcp/ TLS edge + 'static'
Copy this file to your project's .mcp.json (or ~/.claude.json), then export the PAT
That bare export is TRANSIENT — it dies with the shell it was typed in. Persist it
(shell rc file or your secret manager) per docs/mcp-client-setup.md "Make the export
DURABLE", and check the wiring with `rebar doctor`.
Claude Code expands ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLAUDE} from the environment, so NO secret is
stored in this file. Equivalent one-liner:
claude mcp add --transport http rebar https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/ \
GOTCHA: a static Authorization header takes precedence and does NOT fall back to OAuth
if the server rejects it — a wrong/expired PAT fails HARD with a 401, not a silent
OAuth retry. The PAT is the value from the gitignored mcp-clients.local.json (see
mcp-clients.local.example.json and docs/mcp-client-setup.md). Verify: claude mcp list
